g.text: DE/RE low at boot (R32), so the ROM boot log on IO21 never reaches the bus.

g.text: JP1 120 ohm termination: fit a jumper cap on the last device of the bus. J4 has two A/B/GND sets for a pass-through.

g.desc: JP1 120 ohm termination: fit a jumper cap on the last device of the bus. J4 has two A/B/GND sets for a pass-through.

g.text: JP2/JP3 680 ohm fail-safe bias (bridge only if nothing else on the bus biases it).

svg.text: Colour behind a part = its soldering step. A = anode, K = cathode: on the part the cathode is the end with the band.
A net label joins every wire that carries the same name. Pin numbers are the small numbers at each pin.
